Answer: C
Reason: The CT images (Figures 4a and 4b) clearly show hyperdense, metallic-attenuation material within the pulmonary arteries, which is characteristic of polymethylmethacrylate (PMMA) cement embolism, a known complication of vertebroplasty. This finding corresponds to the "hyperdense material in the ventral pulmonary arteries" described in option C.
